title: Pennsylvania Measles Outbreak Continues to Grow
subtitle: State health officials report 55 new cases as vaccination efforts increase across affected areas.

summary.en: Pennsylvania is currently dealing with a serious measles outbreak that has spread across 39 counties. State health officials reported 55 new cases in just two days, bringing the total for the year to 890. While the state is working to provide more vaccines, there is disagreement between local and federal officials regarding the severity of the situation. Measles is a highly contagious disease that can lead to serious health problems. Experts continue to stress that the MMR vaccine is the most effective way to protect the public.
summary.zh: 賓夕法尼亞州目前正處理一場嚴重的麻疹疫情，病毒已蔓延至三十九個郡。州衛生官員在短短兩天內通報了五十五例新增病例，使今年累計總數達到八百九十例。儘管該州正致力於提供更多疫苗，但地方與聯邦官員對於疫情嚴重程度仍存在分歧。麻疹是一種傳染性極強的疾病，可能導致嚴重的健康問題。專家持續強調，麻疹、腮腺炎及德國麻疹混合疫苗是保護大眾最有效的方式。

paragraphs.en: The Pennsylvania Department of Health (DoH) announced on Friday that 55 new cases of measles were reported in the state since Wednesday. This update shows that the virus continues to spread across dozens of counties, causing concern for health officials and local families. Since the outbreak began in late April, the total number of confirmed cases in Pennsylvania has reached 890. According to The Guardian Health, this situation has led to 173 hospitalizations and four deaths linked to the disease.
paragraphs.zh: 賓夕法尼亞州衛生部（Pennsylvania Department of Health, DoH）於週五宣布，自週三以來該州新增五十五例麻疹病例。這項更新顯示病毒持續在數十個郡蔓延，引起衛生官員與當地家庭的擔憂。自四月下旬疫情爆發以來，賓州累計確診病例已達八百九十例。根據《衛報健康》（The Guardian Health）報導，此情況已導致一百七十三人住院，並有四起死亡案例與該疾病有關。

paragraphs.en: Measles is a highly contagious virus that spreads easily through the air when an infected person coughs or sneezes. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) explains that the virus can stay in the air for up to two hours after a sick person has left a room. Common symptoms include a high fever, a cough, a runny nose, and red, watery eyes. These symptoms are usually followed by a rash that starts on the face and moves down the body. While the United States had declared measles eliminated in 2000, the virus has returned in areas where fewer people are vaccinated.
paragraphs.zh: 麻疹是一種傳染性極強的病毒，當感染者咳嗽或打噴嚏時，病毒極易透過空氣傳播。美國疾病管制與預防中心（Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, CDC）說明，病患離開房間後，病毒仍可在空氣中停留長達兩小時。常見症狀包括高燒、咳嗽、流鼻水以及眼睛紅腫流淚。這些症狀通常隨後會出現皮疹，並從臉部開始向下蔓延至全身。儘管美國曾在二〇〇〇年宣布消除麻疹，但該病毒已在疫苗接種率較低的地區捲土重來。

paragraphs.en: Lancaster County has been hit the hardest, recording 359 positive cases so far this year. State health officials noted that 31% of all cases involve people younger than 18. Despite these numbers, the DoH stated that fewer than 1% of the people who caught the virus had been vaccinated. To combat the spread, the state has been running pop-up vaccination clinics. Since April, they have given out more than 5,300 doses of the MMR vaccine—a shot that protects against measles, mumps, and rubella—at 165 different locations. In total, more than 7,900 doses have been given to residents this year.
paragraphs.zh: 蘭卡斯特郡（Lancaster County）受創最深，今年迄今已記錄三百五十九例陽性病例。州衛生官員指出，所有病例中有百分之三十一為十八歲以下族群。儘管數據如此，衛生部表示，感染病毒的人群中，僅不到百分之一曾接種過疫苗。為對抗疫情擴散，該州持續開設臨時疫苗接種站。自四月以來，他們已在一百六十五個不同地點提供了超過五千三百劑麻疹、腮腺炎及德國麻疹混合疫苗（MMR疫苗）。今年總計已為居民施打超過七千九百劑疫苗。

paragraphs.en: The response to the outbreak has become a point of political disagreement. Robert F. Kennedy Jr., the US health secretary, has questioned the reports of deaths related to the disease in Pennsylvania. He suggested on social media that these deaths might have been "fabricated" for political reasons. This follows an earlier decision by the director of the CDC to remove two of Pennsylvania’s reported measles-associated deaths from the national count, citing a need to review more information.
paragraphs.zh: 針對此次疫情的應對措施已成為政治分歧的焦點。美國衛生部長小羅伯特·甘迺迪（Robert F. Kennedy Jr.）對賓州與該疾病相關的死亡報告提出質疑。他在社群媒體上暗示，這些死亡案例可能是為了政治目的而「捏造」的。在此之前，疾病管制與預防中心主任曾因需要審查更多資訊，將賓州通報的兩起麻疹相關死亡案例從全國統計數據中移除。

paragraphs.en: Despite these conflicting messages from federal leaders, Pennsylvania health officials remain focused on increasing vaccination rates. The DoH emphasized that the MMR vaccine is the best way to stay safe, noting that it boosts the immune system and provides 97% lifetime protection. They are currently working with community organizations and doctors to provide clear, fact-based information to the public. More vaccine clinics are planned for the coming weeks to meet the growing interest from residents who want to protect their families.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管聯邦領導層發出的訊息相互矛盾，賓州衛生官員仍專注於提高疫苗接種率。衛生部強調，麻疹、腮腺炎及德國麻疹混合疫苗是保持安全的最有效途徑，並指出該疫苗能增強免疫系統，提供百分之九十七的終身保護力。他們目前正與社區組織及醫師合作，向大眾提供清晰且基於事實的資訊。未來幾週計畫增設更多疫苗接種站，以滿足居民保護家人的需求。

paragraphs.en: Medical experts remind the public that while death from measles is rare, it can happen in one to three out of every 1,000 cases. Because the virus is so easily spread, health officials are urging anyone who has not been vaccinated to visit a clinic as soon as possible. The state continues to monitor the situation closely, hoping that the combination of public education and increased access to vaccines will eventually bring the outbreak to an end. For now, the message from the state remains simple: getting fully vaccinated is the most effective way to stop the virus from spreading further.
paragraphs.zh: 醫學專家提醒大眾，雖然麻疹致死案例罕見，但每千名病例中仍可能發生一至三起死亡案例。由於病毒傳播極易，衛生官員呼籲尚未接種疫苗的民眾儘速前往診所。該州持續密切監控疫情，期望透過公眾教育與增加疫苗取得管道，最終能平息這場疫情。目前，州政府傳達的訊息很簡單：完成疫苗接種是阻止病毒進一步擴散最有效的方法。

quiz.question: Based on the provided text, what is the vaccination status of the majority of people who contracted measles in Pennsylvania?

options.A: They were all fully vaccinated with the MMR shot.
options.B: More than 99% of them had not received the vaccine.
options.C: Approximately 31% of the infected individuals were unvaccinated.
options.D: The majority had received at least one dose of the vaccine earlier this year.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第三段，衛生部門（DoH）指出，感染麻疹的患者中，不到 1% 的人曾接種過疫苗，這意味著超過 99% 的患者未接種。選項 A 與事實完全相反；選項 C 混淆了「18 歲以下患者佔總病例 31%」的數據；選項 D 則與文中提到的低接種率數據矛盾。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the relationship between vaccination rates and the current measles outbreak in Pennsylvania?

options.A: The outbreak is primarily affecting people who have already received the MMR vaccine.
options.B: The state's decision to remove deaths from the count has caused the virus to spread faster.
options.C: Low vaccination rates in certain areas are a significant factor in the virus's ability to circulate.
options.D: The virus is only spreading in areas where there are no pop-up clinics available.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章第二段提到麻疹在疫苗接種率較低的地區捲土重來，且第三段強調感染者中極少數有接種疫苗。由此可推斷，疫苗接種率低是疫情擴散的主因。選項 A 與事實不符；選項 B 提到政治爭議，但文中並未指出這與病毒傳播速度有因果關係；選項 D 過度推論，文中並未說病毒僅限於無診所的地區。

quiz.question: In the fourth paragraph, what does the word 'fabricated' mean as it is used in the context of Robert F. Kennedy Jr.'s social media post?

options.A: Invented or made up to deceive others.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在此上下文中，Robert F. Kennedy Jr. 質疑死亡數據的真實性，認為這些數據可能是為了政治目的而捏造的。'Fabricated' 在此處意指「虛構」或「捏造」。選項 B 是該詞的字面意思（製造），但在文中不適用；選項 C 與 D 的意思與「虛構」完全相反，故皆不正確。

quiz.question: What is the primary message of this article regarding the measles outbreak in Pennsylvania?

options.A: The outbreak is mainly a result of political disagreements between federal and state leaders.
options.B: Medical experts believe that measles is no longer a threat to the general public.
options.C: The state is prioritizing legal action against those who refuse to get vaccinated.
options.D: Health officials are promoting vaccination as the most effective strategy to control the ongoing outbreak.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。文章多次強調疫苗的重要性，並在結尾明確指出「接種疫苗是阻止病毒擴散最有效的方法」。選項 A 雖提及政治爭議，但那只是背景資訊而非主旨；選項 B 與文章內容矛盾，麻疹仍具威脅；選項 C 文中並未提到任何針對未接種者的法律行動，故為錯誤選項。
